name: vael-ui-skills
description: Skills for the vael-ui Vue 3 component library and the vael-form forms library

plugins.name: vael-ui
plugins.description: Installation, usage, and best practices for the vael-ui Vue component library — the vdom/vapor split, auto-import, theming, and the motion system (the motion prop, v-animate, springs, hooks for GSAP or motion).

plugins.name: vael-form
plugins.description: Vue forms with vael-form — useForm on Zod, Valibot, ArkType or any Standard Schema, binding to plain inputs and vael-ui, when errors show, async rules, lists and steps, server errors, i18n, Nuxt, SSR, accessibility, testing, and moving from vee-validate.
